report.incidentSummary: On 2026-10-15 starting around 10:10 IST (04:40 UTC), UPI autopay mandate setups experienced partial failures, lowering overall platform mandate success rates to ~94%. Investigation showed that the failure was strictly isolated to partner bank Sahyadri, whose external mandate API experienced severe latency degradation reaching the 8000ms bank-connector timeout limit. Other partner banks maintained normal success rates (~96%).
report.rootCauseStatement: Partner bank Sahyadri's external mandate API experienced severe latency degradation beginning at 04:40 UTC (10:10 IST), with p95 response times surging from ~1.6s to 8.0s. This caused bank-connector synchronous calls to hit their 8000ms timeout threshold, leading to 402 BANK_TIMEOUT errors and 392 Gateway Timeouts on POST /mandates, dropping Sahyadri mandate success rates to 62–71%.

hypotheses.cause: Partner bank Sahyadri external mandate API experienced severe latency degradation and timeouts, causing bank-connector requests to hit the 8000ms timeout threshold.
hypotheses.rationale: Bank-connector metrics show p95 latency for Sahyadri spiked from 1600ms to ~8000ms at 04:40 UTC, with bank error rate surging to ~34% and timeouts jumping to 10-18/min. Exactly 402 BANK_TIMEOUT errors were logged in mandate-service, all isolated to Sahyadri, while all other partner banks remained healthy.

hypotheses.cause: mandate-service v2.4.0 deployment at 04:22 UTC introduced aggressive status polling that caused throttling or degradation at Sahyadri bank after an 18-minute lag.
hypotheses.rationale: mandate-service v2.4.0 was deployed at 04:22 UTC, but errors and latency spikes did not begin until 04:40 UTC (18 minutes later). Furthermore, all other partner banks (Gomti, Indus Valley, Kaveri, Northstar) experienced zero elevation in timeouts or latency under the new version.

facts.statement: At 2026-10-15T04:22:00.000Z (09:52 IST), mandate-service was deployed from version 2.3.0 to 2.4.0 under CHG-48217.

Mandate success rate for bank Sahyadri dropped sharply from ~96.8% at 04:35 UTC to 82.3% at 04:40 UTC and fluctuated between 62.6% and 71.3% through 07:00 UTC, while all other banks remained above 95.3%.

mandate-service logged 402 ERROR events with error_code BANK_TIMEOUT ('mandate <ref> failed: bank-connector returned BANK_TIMEOUT') between 04:40:02 UTC and 06:59:47 UTC, all 402 belonging to bank Sahyadri.
bank-connector p95 latency for partner bank Sahyadri surged from ~1600ms to 4778ms at 04:40 UTC and sustained at ~8000ms thereafter, while other banks remained between 1600ms and 2500ms.
Partner bank Sahyadri error rate on bank-connector increased from ~0.8% to 15.2% at 04:40 UTC and stayed between 28.7% and 34.0% through 07:00 UTC, with timeouts climbing to 10-18/min.
api-gateway and bank-connector logged 392 Gateway Timeout occurrences on POST /mandates starting at 2026-10-15T04:40:00.011Z.
Database lock wait times (mean 3.93ms) and slow query rates (mean 2.77/min) remained at baseline throughout the window with zero database query or lock errors.
bank-connector calls external bank-apis with a synchronous timeout of 8000ms and 0 retries.

inferences.statement: The issue is not a widespread bug in mandate-service or a global network issue, as all other partner banks (Gomti, Indus Valley, Kaveri, Northstar) maintained healthy success rates and latencies throughout the incident window.

The 18-minute gap between the v2.4.0 deployment (04:22 UTC) and the onset of Sahyadri failures (04:40 UTC), combined with normal metrics across four other banks, indicates the deployment was not the direct trigger of the degradation.
The 8000ms p95 latency plateau on bank-connector for Sahyadri represents calls hitting bank-connector's configured 8000ms timeout waiting for external bank responses.

assumptions.statement: The latency degradation is situated within Sahyadri bank's core banking / mandate infrastructure rather than egress network peering specific to Sahyadri's endpoint.

timeline.event: mandate-service deployed to v2.4.0 under CHG-48217.
Partner bank Sahyadri p95 latency jumps to 4778ms, error rate surges to 15.2%, and mandate success rate drops to 82.3%.
api-gateway and bank-connector log first Gateway Timeout errors on POST /mandates.
mandate-service logs first BANK_TIMEOUT error for bank Sahyadri.
Sahyadri p95 latency reaches 8000ms timeout cap; mandate success rate drops to ~65-70%.
Incident INC-2727 reported by Payments product manager.

confidence.rationale: Clear, unanimous observability metrics from mandate-service, bank-connector, and api-gateway isolate the failures strictly to partner bank Sahyadri API response latency hitting the 8000ms client timeout.

gaps.description: Lack of direct confirmation or status communication from partner bank Sahyadri's operations team regarding internal issues.
gaps.impact: Precludes visibility into Sahyadri's internal failure mode, but does not impact the conclusion that external Sahyadri API calls timed out.

gaps.description: Lack of breakdown of mandate-service status polling volume per partner bank.
gaps.impact: Leaves a small residual possibility that polling volume contributed to bank-specific throttling, though lack of failures in 4 other banks makes this unlikely.

recommendedActions.action: Escalate the incident to partner bank Sahyadri's partner integration / operations team and notify them of elevated latency and 8000ms gateway timeouts.
recommendedActions.rationale: The degradation is caused by external Sahyadri API latency exceeding the 8000ms timeout threshold.
recommendedActions.verification: Check bank-connector bank_latency_p95_ms and bank_error_rate for bank sahyadri returning below 2000ms and 1% respectively.

recommendedActions.action: Temporarily present an in-app advisory or reroute users attempting mandate setup with Sahyadri bank accounts to alternative payment methods (e.g., netbanking or secondary bank) until Sahyadri stabilizes.
recommendedActions.rationale: Prevents users from repeatedly facing mandate setup failures and timeouts.
recommendedActions.verification: Monitor user setup drop-offs and api-gateway timeout error rates.

recommendedActions.action: Implement a circuit breaker or adaptive rate-limiter in bank-connector for partner bank integrations experiencing sustained timeout rates.
recommendedActions.rationale: Failing fast avoids tying up gateway threads and mandate-service worker resources during upstream partner outages.
recommendedActions.verification: Simulate bank upstream latency in staging and verify bank-connector opens circuit and fails fast with 503 instead of 8000ms timeouts.

report.justification: Although the automated investigation completed without formal critic review, the evidence conclusively isolates the root cause to partner bank Sahyadri's external mandate API degradation. Metric and log telemetry across multiple services (mandate-service, bank-connector, api-gateway, database) confirms that all other banks and database subsystems operated normally, while Sahyadri requests specifically breached the 8000ms timeout limit.

keyFacts.statement: Mandate creation failures and BANK_TIMEOUT errors are isolated exclusively to partner bank 'sahyadri', whose mandate success rate dropped from ~96.8% to 62-71% at 04:40 UTC, while other partner banks remained healthy at ~96%.

Bank-connector metrics show Sahyadri p95 latency spiked from ~1600ms to ~8000ms, timeout rate jumped from 0 to 10-18/min, and error rate surged to 28-34% starting at 04:40 UTC, matching the 8000ms connector timeout limit.

# Investigation report: Autopay setup failing for some users

**Outcome:** conclusive · **Stop reason:** completed · **Confidence:** 0.85 · **Written by:** reporting agent

## Summary
On 2026-10-15 starting around 10:10 IST (04:40 UTC), UPI autopay mandate setups experienced partial failures, lowering overall platform mandate success rates to ~94%. Investigation showed that the failure was strictly isolated to partner bank Sahyadri, whose external mandate API experienced severe latency degradation reaching the 8000ms bank-connector timeout limit. Other partner banks maintained normal success rates (~96%).

**Root cause:** Partner bank Sahyadri's external mandate API experienced severe latency degradation beginning at 04:40 UTC (10:10 IST), with p95 response times surging from ~1.6s to 8.0s. This caused bank-connector synchronous calls to hit their 8000ms timeout threshold, leading to 402 BANK_TIMEOUT errors and 392 Gateway Timeouts on POST /mandates, dropping Sahyadri mandate success rates to 62–71%.

## Hypotheses
1. **Partner bank Sahyadri external mandate API experienced severe latency degradation and timeouts, causing bank-connector requests to hit the 8000ms timeout threshold.** — `bank-apis`, upstream_dependency_degradation, confidence 0.85, supported
   - Supporting: [ev_1, ev_4, ev_6, ev_7, ev_8, ev_9, ev_10, ev_12, ev_14, ev_18] · Contradicting: none
   - Bank-connector metrics show p95 latency for Sahyadri spiked from 1600ms to ~8000ms at 04:40 UTC, with bank error rate surging to ~34% and timeouts jumping to 10-18/min. Exactly 402 BANK_TIMEOUT errors were logged in mandate-service, all isolated to Sahyadri, while all other partner banks remained healthy.
2. **mandate-service v2.4.0 deployment at 04:22 UTC introduced aggressive status polling that caused throttling or degradation at Sahyadri bank after an 18-minute lag.** — `mandate-service`, deployment_regression, confidence 0.15, ruled_out
   - Supporting: [ev_3, ev_12, ev_17] · Contradicting: [ev_1, ev_6, ev_8, ev_9]
   - mandate-service v2.4.0 was deployed at 04:22 UTC, but errors and latency spikes did not begin until 04:40 UTC (18 minutes later). Furthermore, all other partner banks (Gomti, Indus Valley, Kaveri, Northstar) experienced zero elevation in timeouts or latency under the new version.

## Facts
- At 2026-10-15T04:22:00.000Z (09:52 IST), mandate-service was deployed from version 2.3.0 to 2.4.0 under CHG-48217. [ev_3, ev_17]
- Mandate success rate for bank Sahyadri dropped sharply from ~96.8% at 04:35 UTC to 82.3% at 04:40 UTC and fluctuated between 62.6% and 71.3% through 07:00 UTC, while all other banks remained above 95.3%. [ev_1]
- mandate-service logged 402 ERROR events with error_code BANK_TIMEOUT ('mandate <ref> failed: bank-connector returned BANK_TIMEOUT') between 04:40:02 UTC and 06:59:47 UTC, all 402 belonging to bank Sahyadri. [ev_4, ev_7, ev_10, ev_12]
- bank-connector p95 latency for partner bank Sahyadri surged from ~1600ms to 4778ms at 04:40 UTC and sustained at ~8000ms thereafter, while other banks remained between 1600ms and 2500ms. [ev_9]
- Partner bank Sahyadri error rate on bank-connector increased from ~0.8% to 15.2% at 04:40 UTC and stayed between 28.7% and 34.0% through 07:00 UTC, with timeouts climbing to 10-18/min. [ev_6, ev_8]
- api-gateway and bank-connector logged 392 Gateway Timeout occurrences on POST /mandates starting at 2026-10-15T04:40:00.011Z. [ev_14]
- Database lock wait times (mean 3.93ms) and slow query rates (mean 2.77/min) remained at baseline throughout the window with zero database query or lock errors. [ev_11, ev_14, ev_15]
- bank-connector calls external bank-apis with a synchronous timeout of 8000ms and 0 retries. [ev_5, ev_18]

## Inferences
- The issue is not a widespread bug in mandate-service or a global network issue, as all other partner banks (Gomti, Indus Valley, Kaveri, Northstar) maintained healthy success rates and latencies throughout the incident window. [ev_1, ev_6, ev_8, ev_9]
- The 18-minute gap between the v2.4.0 deployment (04:22 UTC) and the onset of Sahyadri failures (04:40 UTC), combined with normal metrics across four other banks, indicates the deployment was not the direct trigger of the degradation. [ev_1, ev_3, ev_6, ev_8, ev_9]
- The 8000ms p95 latency plateau on bank-connector for Sahyadri represents calls hitting bank-connector's configured 8000ms timeout waiting for external bank responses. [ev_8, ev_9, ev_14, ev_18]

## Assumptions
- The latency degradation is situated within Sahyadri bank's core banking / mandate infrastructure rather than egress network peering specific to Sahyadri's endpoint.

## Timeline
- **2026-10-15 09:52 IST (04:22 UTC)** mandate-service deployed to v2.4.0 under CHG-48217. [ev_3, ev_17]
- **2026-10-15 10:10 IST (04:40 UTC)** Partner bank Sahyadri p95 latency jumps to 4778ms, error rate surges to 15.2%, and mandate success rate drops to 82.3%. [ev_1, ev_6, ev_9]
- **2026-10-15 10:10:00 IST (04:40:00 UTC)** api-gateway and bank-connector log first Gateway Timeout errors on POST /mandates. [ev_14]
- **2026-10-15 10:10:02 IST (04:40:02 UTC)** mandate-service logs first BANK_TIMEOUT error for bank Sahyadri. [ev_4, ev_12]
- **2026-10-15 10:15 IST (04:45 UTC)** Sahyadri p95 latency reaches 8000ms timeout cap; mandate success rate drops to ~65-70%. [ev_1, ev_8, ev_9]
- **2026-10-15 11:15 IST (05:45 UTC)** Incident INC-2727 reported by Payments product manager.

## Confidence
0.85: Clear, unanimous observability metrics from mandate-service, bank-connector, and api-gateway isolate the failures strictly to partner bank Sahyadri API response latency hitting the 8000ms client timeout.

## Gaps
- Lack of direct confirmation or status communication from partner bank Sahyadri's operations team regarding internal issues. (impact: Precludes visibility into Sahyadri's internal failure mode, but does not impact the conclusion that external Sahyadri API calls timed out.)
- Lack of breakdown of mandate-service status polling volume per partner bank. (impact: Leaves a small residual possibility that polling volume contributed to bank-specific throttling, though lack of failures in 4 other banks makes this unlikely.)

## Recommended actions (not executed)
- **[now]** Escalate the incident to partner bank Sahyadri's partner integration / operations team and notify them of elevated latency and 8000ms gateway timeouts. [ev_6, ev_8, ev_9]
  - Why: The degradation is caused by external Sahyadri API latency exceeding the 8000ms timeout threshold.
  - Verify: Check bank-connector bank_latency_p95_ms and bank_error_rate for bank sahyadri returning below 2000ms and 1% respectively.
- **[now]** Temporarily present an in-app advisory or reroute users attempting mandate setup with Sahyadri bank accounts to alternative payment methods (e.g., netbanking or secondary bank) until Sahyadri stabilizes. [ev_1, ev_14]
  - Why: Prevents users from repeatedly facing mandate setup failures and timeouts.
  - Verify: Monitor user setup drop-offs and api-gateway timeout error rates.
- **[next]** Implement a circuit breaker or adaptive rate-limiter in bank-connector for partner bank integrations experiencing sustained timeout rates. [ev_8, ev_9, ev_18]
  - Why: Failing fast avoids tying up gateway threads and mandate-service worker resources during upstream partner outages.
  - Verify: Simulate bank upstream latency in staging and verify bank-connector opens circuit and fails fast with 503 instead of 8000ms timeouts.

## Justification
Although the automated investigation completed without formal critic review, the evidence conclusively isolates the root cause to partner bank Sahyadri's external mandate API degradation. Metric and log telemetry across multiple services (mandate-service, bank-connector, api-gateway, database) confirms that all other banks and database subsystems operated normally, while Sahyadri requests specifically breached the 8000ms timeout limit.
